evidence.summary: 为 DSH 开发者提供状态机、数据模型、结构图与并发声称检查工具和 Skill，返回模型判决、反例、回归及覆盖边界。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 package.json、README.md、src/index.ts、lib/index.js、src/tool.ts、src/engine.ts、src/report-view.ts、src/baseline.ts、src/report-diff-tool.ts、src/compose-tool.ts、src/data-tool.ts、src/structure-tool.ts、src/structure.ts、src/concurrency.ts、src/export-tool.ts、src/exporters.ts、skills/logicprobe/SKILL.md；DSH工具调用本地闭合模型引擎；首次gate/动态交互提示，full/digest与绝对/增量报告分层。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)。
limitations: 旧五题/全部findings和自身code依赖已复核；本轮核package/README、src/lib入口、主工具和state engine校验/探索/未决/结果、report-view、baseline，及data/compose/structure/concurrency/export实际调用与局部算法。未全审每个数据/UML/多层/概率算法和Python/各Agent替代路径，不执行目标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 为能复核模型的开发者，将设计/重构声称接到可执行模型、反例与版本报告。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
DSH工具调用本地闭合模型引擎；首次gate/动态交互提示，full/digest与绝对/增量报告分层。见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)。

旧五题/全部findings和自身code依赖已复核；本轮核package/README、src/lib入口、主工具和state engine校验/探索/未决/结果、report-view、baseline，及data/compose/structure/concurrency/export实际调用与局部算法。未全审每个数据/UML/多层/概率算法和Python/各Agent替代路径，不执行目标。
dsh-logicprobe 1.4.3 MIT，Node>=20并限定DSH peers；作者称后继dsh-model-everything和兼容实测，非本轮后继研究/运行验证。
建模、源码映射/解释和扩大预算是专业成本，无净节时或金额对照；成本表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
能核对源码模型的小型协议/状态机可有限试用；先保full/预算/版本，模型不可核、持续未决或仅单一pass验收时停自动链，回普通测试/专用检查。见[Q04](#research-q04)。
重复反例/报告比口头判断可追溯，真实源码召回和收益未知；效果表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
值得迁移的是封闭模型和显式结果分层；提示确认、_元数据、digest与delta必须保持边界，消费者需联合判读。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
模型检查、Skill方法、反例/哈希和前后/delta报告连接Agent审查，超出口头自信但不自动证明源码。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
ask/auto非强制确认闸；预算/叙述/元数据边界不能靠ok或单一verdict概括，delta可掩已存在/升级错误，源码映射仍人工。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
未验证方向是独立来源/确认审查记录与报告消费规则，已有file:line和元数据之上新增变更失效绑定，已知错误盲测收益/工时否定。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
基础检查需兼容DSH与建模能力，专用求解器按语义另需；依赖表见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)既有模型检查/Skill组合novelty小幅9；[Q02](#research-q02)封闭模型/可执行反例及[Q03](#research-q03)多报告语义取实质mechanism15，非新算法23；结果分层可条件迁移实质10；DSH路由/运行/报告接线实质简化8，但建模仍重非显著12。假设不计。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)从口头审查转建模+核验+回源是实质workflow18；[Q02](#research-q02)反例/哈希/完整报告及[Q03](#research-q03)delta/current使交付可复核取实质15但无验收收益到23；Agent入口reach小幅5；[Q04](#research-q04)无净成本结构证据取0，不把本地执行称免费。

recommendation.reason: 能够人工核对源码和抽象模型的 DSH 开发者，可以在小型协议或状态机上试用，并保留模型、假设、预算与完整报告。它比口头审查多可重复反例和版本对比，但 ask/auto 是提示控制，判决也不能代替源码对应关系、截断检查和当前绝对结果。模型无法核对、持续未决或只能拿单一 pass 作为验收时，应停自动放行，回到源码测试或专用检查器。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)Skill声称核查和真实工具支撑设计/重构反复难验证摩擦，超过泛用途15；无频次/持续需求与原办法不足用户证据，不到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)真实引擎/反例/哈希和[Q03](#research-q03)前后/diff超出文字提示6，增量具体；源码对应仍人工、摘要/确认/delta误读风险且召回对照无，不到19。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)真实lib/src集成、[Q02](#research-q02)校验/预算/未决/摘要及[Q03](#research-q03)分支/diff支撑限定小模型试用，超过片段6；未运行/未全审各家族语义，证据不够19。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)源码映射/不变量建模/未决解释是重要专业负担，跨工具升级和同步成本未测；虽退出不回写目标代码，修正报告不等业务正确，无足够简单可控恢复到10；小样路线存在所以非0。

publication.summaries.text: 为 DSH 开发者提供状态机、数据模型、结构图与并发声称检查工具和 Skill，返回模型判决、反例、回归及覆盖边界。

items.Skill: 声称核查、模型与各领域路由方法
items.模型工具: 状态机/数据/组合/图/声称/导出/报告对比
items.事件监听: pre-step首次会话gate，非确认强制闸

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 模型验证 | 对状态/迁移不变量给反例 | 先核模型对应真实代码，预算未决保留 |
| 图/声称 | 依赖矩阵和并发风险路由 | 图非源码，声称扫描非并发证明 |
| 前后/报告 | 版本回归与delta/current比较 | changed及绝对fail不能忽略 |
| 外部导出 | 生成专业工具输入 | 性质子集warning，需另跑求解器 |
| Skill/gate | 建模方法和报告阅读入口 | auto可未确认，提示不是硬闸 |

publication.advice.text: 能核对源码模型的小型协议/状态机可有限试用；先保full/预算/版本，模型不可核、持续未决或仅单一pass验收时停自动链，回普通测试/专用检查。见[Q04](#research-q04)。

\n\n> **状态**：本插件核验设计、代码与计划中的声称。它继续以 `dsh-model-everything`\n> 的形式发展，同样覆盖声称、行为、结构、UML、数据模型、并发、导出与报告对比，\n> 并加上设计原则审查（分层、边界、可替换性、接口宽度、图形状）、报告阅读技能、\n> 标签口径解释和可选的会话启动路由。它不是本插件的 API 镜像：UML 能力拆在多个\n> 工具里，本插件只有一个 `logicprobe_uml`。它已发布为\n> [`dsh-model-everything`](https://github.com/AmethystLuna/dsh-model-everything)\n> （[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-everything)）。现有安装继续可用。\n> 0.2.1-rc.4 上已实测安装、挂载、启动、工具调用与卸载；逐版本证据见\n> [DSH-COMPATIBILITY.md](DSH-COMPATIBILITY.md)。\n\n没验证过的设计，翻车只是时间问题；再复杂的代码，建模再跑就清楚了。\n\nlogicprobe 核验声称与实物是否一致。事实类对着源码查。行为类跑模型：状态机、协议、组合、数据模型、迁移。图按依赖图读，单层或多层。改动前后用基线对比。验不了的维度明说，并指出该用哪个工具。\n\n**跨平台**：支持 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor、Kimi CLI、OpenCode、ZCode。技能基于 [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) 开放标准。\n\n> **用例图与其它 UML 图族**：本插件只建模状态机与流程。用例图（`:Actor: --> (UseCase)`）、类图、\n> 组件图、部署图等会被**按名拒绝**，不会被误读成状态机。需要完整 14 类 UML 2.5 图族的\n> render/parse/review 时，用 [dsh-model-everything](https://github.com/AmethystLuna/dsh-model-everything)：\n> 它承接了本插件的全部图能力（记号语法引擎、能力矩阵、用例与结构族模块）。\n\n## 功能\n\n| 阶段 | 内容 |\n|------|------|\n| Phase 1-2 | 枚举每个可验证声称：API 名、文件路径、枚举值、数量、机制可行性。逐条对照代码库给出证据。 |\n| Phase 2a | 对提取的状态机模型执行 **8 项结构检查（S1-S8）**：S1 可达性、S2 死锁、S3 活性、S4 确定性、S5 事件完备性、S6 守卫完备性、S7 不变量有效性、S8 单调变量。 |\n| Phase 2b | **14 项对抗探针（A1-A14）**：意外事件、竞态交错、顺序置换、配对对称（lock/unlock，含 onEntry/onExit 隐式配对）、边界轰炸、资源注入、最小反例、幂等重放、必达、顺序、原子性、预算（A12 最坏路径代价，含正成本环检测）、概率可达（A13）、期限（A14）。 |\n| 重构模式 | 对比前后模型：行为保持、不变量连续性、死锁回归、复杂度声称。 |\n| 数据模型模式 | 验证 DataModelV1 数据模型（DS/DA/DD）：迁移覆盖、copy 一致性、before/after 破坏性变更回归。 |\n| UML 建模与审查 | 用 UML 画出代码流程，再审查这份建模本身：结构缺陷、文档缺口、图与模型的往返保真度。 |\n| 并发风险挖掘 | 扫描文档与计划中的并发安全声称（thread-safe、lock-free、race condition、中断安全等），标记出来交给专用验证。 |\n| 输出 | 结构化发现：精确 file:line 证据、严重性分级、修正方向。核查过程中绝不直接改代码。报告附带 `coverageNotes`，把时序、抢占、混合控制、概率等词汇路由到外部工具（UPPAAL、TSan、CBMC、TLA+、SpaceEx、PRISM 等），见 `skills/logicprobe/references/gap-routing-guide.md`。模型可携带自然语言 `narrative`（状态、事件、场景注释），报告原样回显。 |\n\n模型永远先以转换表形式展示，**经用户确认后才运行**。模型提取错误是验证的头号失败模式。\n\n## 工具与报告\n\n下面两份清单（原生工具清单，以及怎么读它们的报告）与**安装方式无关**：dsh 走原生工具，Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / 终端 / CI 走同一套技能与 Python CLI 引擎（见「使用」）。\n\n工具清单：\n\n| 工具 | 作用 |\n|------|------|\n| `logicprobe_verify` | 状态机验证：S1-S8 结构检查 + A1-A14 对抗探针。传 `beforeModel` 与 condition、mutex 等），标注需要专用验证。 |\n| `logicprobe_compose_verify` | 两台及以上状态机组合验证（握手 rendezvous 语义）：C1 组合死锁、C2 握手永不触发。 |\n| `logicprobe_export` | 导出外部工具原生输入：UPPAAL（`.xta` + queries）、TLA+（TLC 模块）、PRISM（DTMC `.pm` + `.pctl`）、SPIN（Promela + ltl）。 |\n| `logicprobe_uml` | 用 UML 建模代码流程，并审查这份建模。见下方「UML 建模与审查」。 |\n| `logicprobe_structure_verify` | 把组件/包/类/部署图当**依赖图**审查（UML020-UML026）：孤立节点、悬空端点、依赖环、违反允许依赖矩阵的边、跨层反向依赖、矩阵要求却缺失的边；每条被判定的边都会报出命中的规则 id。它审的是**图**，代码侧要用 include/依赖扫描对账。 |\n| `logicprobe_report_diff` | 对比两份同族报告（baseline vs current），给出新增/消除/变化的发现与**增量**判定：按 `检查 id + code + 机器可读定位（evidence/path）` 匹配，改措辞只会算作 `changed`；新增 error 判 fail，而 `currentVerdict` 仍保留本次运行的绝对结论。\"违规不增\"的验收判据，算出来而不是看出来的。 |\n\n迁移代价用 `cost`（缺省 1），配 `budget` 不变量即由 A12 检查最坏路径代价，正成本环会被判为无界。迁移权重用 `weight`（缺省 1），配 `probability` 不变量即由 A13 计算概率可达。状态上的 `onEntry`/`onExit` 动作由 A4 自动纳入配对检查，`maxTicks` 加 `tickEvents` 由 A14 检查期限。\n\n### 怎么读报告（`ok` 不是结论）\n\n所有报告都同时给「工具跑成功」与「审查通过」两件事：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|------|------|\n| `schema` | 版本化报告契约（`logicprobe/verify/v1`、`logicprobe/uml/review/v1`…），消费方按它分支而不是猜字段。 |\n| `ok` | 引擎产出了报告。对 `verify` 只在**模型校验失败**时为 `false`；它**不是**结论。 |\n| `ran` | 工具确实执行了。仅在工具层拒绝请求（带 `errorCode`/`error`）时为 `false`。 |\n| `verdict` | `pass` / `pass_with_findings` / `fail`。任何 `severity: \"error\"` 的发现、或校验失败，都会是 `fail`。 |\n| `verdictReason` | 一行说明，例如 `1 error finding(s) (first: S2_NO_TRANSITIONS)`。 |\n| `hashSpec` | `modelHash` 依据的已发布规范（见 [`hash-spec.md`](skills/logicprobe/references/hash-spec.md)）。 |\n| `hashes` | 本次报告涉及的全部哈希集中一处（模型哈希、图/矩阵哈希、前后模型哈希）。 |\n| `metadataKeys` | 输入里带 `_` 前缀的注记键路径（仅当存在时出现）。 |\n| `narrativeCoverage` | `{states: \"5/5\", events: \"3/9\", scenarios: \"0/12\"}`：narrative **允许部分覆盖**，这里报告还差多少；缺口同时是一条 `NARRATIVE_PARTIAL`（info）发现，门禁不必去解析 `nextSteps` 文本。 |\n| `nextSteps` | 由发现推导的下一步，永不为空，同一输入两次运行逐字一致。 |\n\n只看 `ok` 会把「有死锁」的模型读成通过——判据是 `verdict`。非 DSH 的 Python CLI 退出码跟随 verdict：`pass`/`pass_with_findings` → `0`，`fail` 或拒绝 → `2`。\n\n**工具打印的是报告正文，不是 JSON。** 结构化报告本身没有变（`schema`/`verdict`/`hashes`/检查项 id/`code`/`evidence`/`path` 都在），变的只是给模型看的那份文本：\n\n- 通过的检查只出现在 `CHECKS` 清单行里，不再展开正文（通过的检查没有可行动内容）；\n- 同一个事实被多个检查各报一遍时（例如 `S5` 与 `A1` 报同一批 `(state, event)` 对），只在先出现的检查里列出，后出现的检查写明「与上面重复」，不再重印；\n- 同一检查内逐字相同的发现折叠成一行并标注 `(xN)`；\n- 只有 `error` 级发现内联 `evidence`，`warning` 级不内联——那是机器字段，不是阅读材料。\n\n需要结构化报告本体时传 `reportView: \"full\"`（例如要把它交给 `logicprobe_report_diff`，它按 `check + code + evidence` 匹配身份，正文替代不了对象）。非 dsh 宿主走 CLI，它直接打印报告 JSON：那份正文是 dsh 工具的呈现层。\n\n### 模型自带的归档记录（`_` 前缀键）\n\n任何以 `_` 开头的键（任意层级，如 `_source`、`_verified`、`_extraction_caveats`、`states[0]._note`）都是**注记元数据**：schema 跳过、`modelHash` 排除、报告以 `metadataKeys` 回显。这样来源与验证快照可以跟模型放在同一个文件里，不必再维护一个会漂移的 sidecar，而模型的哈希身份不变。其余键仍然闭合——拼错的 `sttes` 依旧报错。用 `verify model.json --hash-check ` 可回答某个历史哈希是否属于任何已发布规范。\n\n## UML 建模与审查\n\n`logicprobe_uml` 把一份 LogicModelV1 画成 UML，也可以把手绘的 UML 读回模型，还可以审查建模本身，或打印解析器接受的标签与注释口径。它有 4 个动作：\n\n- **render**：模型 → 图。Mermaid 支持状态图、活动流程图、时序图；PlantUML 支持状态图与时序图。notation 表达不了的构造会变成 warning，不会被悄悄丢掉。PlantUML 活动图直接拒绝，因为它的语法无法忠实承载带合流或环的图。视图由问题决定、不由模型决定，所以工具不替你选：用 `intent`（`present`/`verify`/`fidelity`）声明产物用途，服务不了的组合在开工之前就拒（`UML_INTENT_UNSERVABLE`、`UML_VIEW_UNREPRESENTABLE`、`UML_INTENT_MISMATCH`）；不给 `intent` 则行为与从前完全一致。\n- **parse**：图 → 模型。支持 Mermaid 与 PlantUML 的状态图、活动图，因此手绘的图也能送进 `logicprobe_verify` 验证。两类输入会被拒绝，因为它们无法变成状态机：时序图（迹无法重建机），以及**其它 Mermaid 图族**（`classDiagram`、`erDiagram`、`gantt`、`mindmap`…），返回 `errorCode: \"UML_NOT_A_STATE_DIAGRAM\"` 并点名该图族。\n- **review**：审查建模。它报告两类问题。结构缺陷包括不可达状态、死端、歧义分支、无出口自环、重复迁移。文档缺口包括缺 narrative、变量无界、状态无可读标注、图与 narrative 标签漂移。它还会做保真度检查：把图重新解析回模型，任何结构性差异都报出来。\n- **explain-labels**：打印解析器接受的标签写法与忽略行口径（`directiveLines`、`acceptedLabelForms`、`renderedForm`、`ignoredLines`、`rules`），不需要给图。手绘图与渲染图对不齐时先看它；命令行对应 `uml-review --explain-labels`。\n\n**结构图是最危险的一类，因为它「能解析」。** PlantUML 的组件图 / 包图 / 类图 / 部署图不声明图类型，解析器会逐行碰上它的关键字。箭头看起来就是迁移，于是 `parse` 会返回一个副产品模型——但现在同时给出 error 级发现 `UML_NOT_A_STATE_DIAGRAM`、`discardedConstructs`（每条无法表达的声明及其行号与原文）、`discardedEdges`（被误读成迁移的箭头数），以及 `verdict: \"fail\"`。意思是：**这份文件没有被建模，这张图没有被审查。** 不要把那个副产品喂给 `logicprobe_verify` 当作架构审查结论。真正的依赖图检查（允许依赖矩阵、环、孤立节点）由 `logicprobe_structure_verify` 承担，见下方「架构与依赖审查」。\n\n保真度是这套功能的核心。生成的图带有 `logicprobe:` 注释指令（init、终态、别名、变量类型），Mermaid 与 PlantUML 会忽略它们，而解析器会读取它们。因此「图 ↔ 模型」的比较是精确的。\n\n审查只覆盖建模，不覆盖行为。每条发现都会指明应该跑哪一项引擎检查。判据是 `verdict`（`fail` 表示有 error 级发现，图**未**通过审查），不是 `ok`。完整清单（`UML001`-`UML019` 加 `UML_NOT_A_STATE_DIAGRAM`）、指令格式、示例与各视图局限见 [`skills/logicprobe/references/uml-modeling-guide.md`](skills/logicprobe/references/uml-modeling-guide.md)。\n\n## 架构与依赖审查\n\n组件图不是状态机，它是一张**有向依赖图**。`logicprobe_structure_verify` 把同一份 PlantUML 组件/包/类/部署图（或 Mermaid 类图）解析成真正的节点与边——不再丢弃——然后逐项检查：\n\n| 检查 | 严重度 | 含义 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `UML020_ISOLATED_NODE` | warning | 已声明且非容器的节点一条边都没有：死条目，或漏画的依赖 |\n| `UML021_DANGLING_REFERENCE` | error | 箭头端点从未被声明——依赖指向了根本不存在的组件 |\n| `UML022_CYCLE` | error | 有向环，给出**最短环**路径；环意味着没有构建顺序、没有分层 |\n| `UML023_DISALLOWED_EDGE` | error | 违反允许依赖矩阵的边（`default: deny` 时未被任何规则允许的边也算） |\n| `UML024_LAYER_VIOLATION` | error | 从下层指向已声明上层的反向依赖（向下允许、向上禁止） |\n| `UML025_MISSING_EXPECTED_EDGE` | warning | `require: true` 要求存在的边图里没有；矩阵与图不一致 |\n\n**多粒度**:同一套图可以按层级给出来 —— `diagrams: [{name, diagram, parent}]` —— 每一层先各自跑上面的结构检查(发现按 `file` 标注来源),再逐对做**细化校验**:子图不得在父层节点之间凭空造出依赖,也不得丢掉父图的边而不把它展开成路径(展开成路径的会列进 `expandedEdges` 供人确认);父图关系成环报 `UML030`,父图未知名报 `UML028`。每对还给出节点/边/继承/新增/展开/丢失/造出的计数(`pairs[]`),并给每层记 sha256(`hashes.diagrams`),这样\"哪一层动了\"可以由 `--baseline` 直接算出来。命令:`structure diagram.puml` 审单图,`granularity manifest.json` 审多层。\n\n依赖矩阵就是单一事实源，JSON 形式：\n\n```json\n{\n \"rules\": [\n { \"id\": \"R1-app-may-use-hal\", \"source\": \"app.*\", \"allow\": [\"hal.*\"], \"deny\": [\"hal.internal\"] },\n { \"id\": \"R4-persistence-required\", \"source\": \"PAY\", \"allow\": [\"DB\"], \"require\": true }\n ],\n \"layers\": [{ \"name\": \"app\", \"members\": [\"SVC\", \"PAY\"] }, { \"name\": \"hal\", \"members\": [\"DRV\", \"DB\"] }],\n \"default\": \"deny\"\n}\n```\n\n`source`/`allow`/`deny`/`members` 支持 glob（`*`、`?`）；**`deny` 全局优先**，结果不依赖规则书写顺序；矩阵写错（键名拼错、规则 id 重复、`require` 没有 `allow`）是硬错误 `MATRIX_INVALID`，不会静默放宽检查。每条边都会在 `edgeVerdicts` 里回显 `{from, to, matchedRules, allowed, basis}`。\n\n**不做的事说得清楚**:写点分析(\"只有 ISR 写这个标志\"\"一个寄存器只有一个写者\")**不在本插件射程**——它需要读源码与语句级规则,不是模型或图;这类声称由 `logicprobe_concurrency_scan` 标为未验证并路由到源码侧检查(自己的 include/arch 检查器、静态分析器或 CBMC)。\n\n**它审的是图，不是代码。** 函数指针、DI、注册表、插件加载这些运行期依赖不会出现在边上；干净的 `pass` 只说明\"画出来的图自洽且满足矩阵\"。真正碰代码的那一步是**对账**：与源码侧的 include/依赖扫描（例如你们自己的 include/依赖检查脚本）用同一套规则 id 跑一遍，差异按四类定性——图漏了代码里有的边（图过期，`require` 时由 `UML025` 报出）、图画了代码里没有的边（图是愿景，或扫描范围更窄）、代码违反了图里没画出的规则（**图掩盖的架构缺陷**，这条才是要动手的）、两边一致判违规（真违规）。完整矩阵 schema、worked example 与对账表见 [`skills/logicprobe-structure/references/structure-review-guide.md`](skills/logicprobe-structure/references/structure-review-guide.md)。\n\n## 使用\n\n插件在会话首个模型步骤自动注入能力通知。技能按**领域**拆分;`logicprobe` 是总入口,只要有一点「想验证代码/某个说法是否成立」的念头就加载它,它自己的路由表再把相邻领域交出去:\n\n| 技能 | 领域 | 典型触发 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `logicprobe` | 声称核查 + 行为验证(状态机/协议、时序与量化保证、组合、重构回归) | \"Review this design document\"、\"could this state machine deadlock\"、\"is this retry limit safe\"、\"这个预算够不够\" |\n| `logicprobe-uml` | 图的建模与审查 | \"把这个状态机画出来\"、\"这份 UML 图对吗\"、\"component 图能不能当状态机审\" |\n| `logicprobe-structure` | 架构 / 依赖结构审查 | \"审查一下这个架构\"、\"模块依赖有没有问题\"、\"分层对不对\" |\n| `logicprobe-concurrency` | 并发声称:挖矿 + 路由(不证明) | \"thread-safe 吗\"、\"这个 ISR 会 race 吗\" |\n| `logicprobe-datamodel` | 数据模型 / 迁移与不变量 | \"is this migration non-breaking\"、\"这份 copy 覆盖全字段了吗\" |\n\n行为类问题仍按\"主动建议、不自动升级\"处理:先建议一次可选验证,由你决定是否跑。技能在 Phase 0 依据计划特征自动分级(LIGHTWEIGHT / STANDARD / ESCALATED),并在计划文件追加 `## Plan Verification` 摘要块作为审计痕迹。\n\n在 dsh 之外（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、终端、CI），装的是**仓库**（marketplace / git），随仓库带 `tools/python/logicprobe-engine.py`：只需 Python 3.8+ 标准库。dsh 安装包（npm / bundle）不含它。已有 LogicModelV1 JSON 时直接运行：\n\n- `verify` 跑 S1-S8 / A1-A14 / D1-D4（`--before-model`、`--baseline`、`--hash-spec`、`--hash-check`）\n- `compose` 跑 C1 / C2 组合\n- `export` 生成 UPPAAL、TLA+、PRISM、SPIN 输入\n- `uml-render`、`uml-parse`、`uml-review` 覆盖 UML 前端（`uml-review --explain-labels` 打印解析器接受的标签与注释口径）\n- `structure`、`granularity` 审查依赖图与多粒度细化（UML020-UML031）\n- 子命令的权威清单是 `--help`，本文不复制一份\n\n凡引擎实现的子命令，其报告与 dsh 工具逐字节一致，对照见 `tests/python/run.mjs`。模型只有抽取出的状态表时，填充模板 `tools/python/verification-harness.py`。**数据模型验证没有镜像子命令**：非 dsh 宿主用 `tools/python/data-model-harness.py`，或对应 guide 的手动验证模式；并发声称扫描同理（它只做分流）。Python 不可用（例如离线开发机）时，对应 guide 提供手动验证模式。\n\n示例模型见 [`examples/`](examples/README.md)：订单状态机 before/after、电商数据模型、User 字段迁移。\n\n## 安装\n\n### Claude Code（推荐）\n\n在 **Claude Code** 的 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中添加 marketplace：\n\n```json\n{\n \"extraKnownMarketplaces\": {\n \"logicprobe\": {\n \"source\": { \"source\": \"github\", \"repo\": \"AmethystLuna/logicprobe\" }\n }\n }\n}\n```\n\n然后通过 CLI 安装：\n\n```bash\nclaude plugin install logicprobe@logicprobe\n```\n\n### Claude Code 手动安装\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git ~/.claude/plugins/dev/logicprobe\n```\n\n然后在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中启用：\n\n```json\n{\n \"enabledPlugins\": {\n \"logicprobe@dev\": true\n }\n}\n```\n\n### DeepSeek Harness (dsh)\n\n原生 dsh 支持以 cordis 插件 bundle 的形式提供，位于**仓库根**，由根 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle` 声明。\n\n这个 bundle 做三件事：\n\n1. **注册技能。** 技能遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，由 dsh 的 `skill-filesystem` provider 原样发现，不需要额外代码。\n2. **注入门禁文本。** 每个会话的第一个模型步骤会收到 claim 验证门禁（主动建议）。这是 Claude `SessionStart` hook 在 dsh 上的对应物。\n3. **注册原生工具与上下文。** 工具挂在 `ctx.tools` 上，另有一条策略感知上下文 `logicprobe:mode`（`ctx.systemPrompt`），以及模型可见目录条目（`cordis_inspect`）。\n\n```bash\n# 从 npm 安装（包名 dsh-logicprobe）\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-logicprobe\n# 或从 GitHub 源码安装\ndsh plugin --profile web add \"github:AmethystLuna/logicprobe\"\n# 未全局安装 dsh 时可用 npx\nnpx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-logicprobe\n```\n\n装完重启 profile。运行 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 应看到 `id: logicprobe` 且 `enabled: true`。更多方式（纯技能拷贝、项目级等）见 [`.dsh/INSTALL.md`](.dsh/INSTALL.md)。\n\npnpm 11 有一个发布年龄闸门。它挡住发布不满一天的新版本（`minimumReleaseAge`，默认 1440 分钟），而且默认是非严格模式，所以裸名安装会**静默装到上一个版本**，profile 看起来像这次发版没发生。发版后约 24 小时内要装最新版，请带上版本号：\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-logicprobe@\n```\n\npnpm 会把该版本写进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` 条目。那是它官方的豁免方式。\n\n> 注意包名。npm 包名是 `dsh-logicprobe`，没有 scope。在 web profile 的 `package.json` 中，依赖键与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 必须都写 `dsh-logicprobe`。写错时 dsh 加载器找不到 `node_modules/dsh-logicprobe`，启动会失败。\n\n### Codex CLI\n\n本插件同样支持 OpenAI Codex CLI。技能遵循 Agent Skills 标准，两个平台行为一致。\n\n```bash\n# 添加 marketplace\ncodex plugin marketplace add AmethystLuna/logicprobe\n\n# 安装\ncodex plugin install logicprobe\n```\n\n或手动：\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git ~/.codex/plugins/logicprobe\n```\n\n技能通过 `$logicprobe` 调用，或由 Codex 根据任务上下文自动选择。\n\n### Cursor\n\nCursor 2.5+ 内置插件支持。\n\n```bash\n# 克隆到 Cursor 插件目录\ngit clone https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git ~/.cursor/plugins/logicprobe\n```\n\n或通过 Cursor 插件市场 UI 安装：`/add-plugin AmethystLuna/logicprobe`\n\n### Kimi CLI\n\nKimi CLI 自动从 `.claude/skills/` 路径发现技能。`.kimi-plugin/plugin.json` 清单向 Kimi 插件管理器注册本插件。\n\n```bash\n# 通过 Kimi 插件管理器\n/plugins install https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git\n\n# 或手动克隆\ngit clone https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git ~/.kimi/plugins/logicprobe\n```\n\n技能通过 `/skill:logicprobe` 调用。\n\n### OpenCode\n\n技能自动从 `.claude/skills/` 和 `.codex/skills/` 路径发现。在 `opencode.json` 中添加：\n\n```json\n{\n \"plugin\": [\"logicprobe@git+https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git\"]\n}\n```\n\n或通过 `skop` 安装（消费 Claude marketplace 清单）。详见 `.opencode/INSTALL.md`。\n\n### ZCode (Z.AI)\n\nZCode 3.0+ 遵循 Agent Skills 标准。它没有插件市场，手动把技能复制过去：\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/AmethystLuna/logicprobe.git\ncp -r logicprobe/skills/* .zcode/skills/\n```\n\n技能通过 `$logicprobe` 调用。详见 `.zcode/INSTALL.md`。\n\n## 环境要求\n\n- 宿主：Claude Code v2.1+ / Codex CLI 最新 / Cursor 2.5+ / Kimi CLI 最新 / OpenCode 最新 / ZCode 3.0+\n- DeepSeek Harness (dsh)：dev preview，声明支持 `>= 0.1.0-rc.7`。最新一轮在 0.2.1-rc.4 上实测了安装、挂载、启动与卸载；更早一轮实测覆盖 0.1.5-rc.2 到 0.2.1-rc.3。逐版本证据见 [DSH-COMPATIBILITY.md](DSH-COMPATIBILITY.md)。\n- Web 端的「Gate 注入」开关需要 **dsh ≥ 0.1.7-alpha.1**，因为设置服务必须能投影即时字段。更早的 dsh 上插件照常加载、照常注入，只是开关不出现，也不报错。\n- Python 3.8+（标准库），在 dsh 之外运行验证所需；手动兜底模式不需要任何依赖。\n\n## 配置\n\n在 DeepSeek Harness 中，bundle 支持以下配置：\n\n| 键 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 设为 `false` 可关闭首步 Gate 注入。 |\n| `gateContent` | string | 内置 gate 文本 | 覆盖注入到首轮模型上下文中的文本。 |\n| `interaction` | `ask` \\| `auto` \\| `follow-approval` | `follow-approval` | 模型确认策略。`follow-approval` 在会话 approval policy 为 `never` 时解析为 `auto`。 |\n\n在 dsh Web GUI 里可以直接改这个开关：侧边栏 **插件** → 本插件卡片 → 「Gate 注入」。它实时生效，不必重启 profile。它只管注入的那段文本：关掉后 skills 与验证工具照常注册。同一张卡片上还有一个更粗粒度的行开关，关掉它会整行卸载插件，技能、工具和这个开关一起消失。要持久化覆盖，仍按下面的 profile patch 写。\n\n在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中按 row id 覆盖：\n\n```yaml\n- insert:\n - id: logicprobe\n name: 'dsh-logicprobe'\n config:\n enabled: true\n interaction: follow-approval\n gateContent: |\n ...\n```\n\n## 卸载\n\n- 通过 DSH 插件管理器安装的，用同一管理器从目标 profile 中移除 `logicprobe`。\n- 手动复制过 `skills/*` 的，删除 `~/.agents/skills/` 或项目 `.dsh/skills/` 下的对应目录。\n- 通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 添加的，删除 profile patch 中 `id: logicprobe` 的行，并重启 DSH。\n\n## 权限与数据\n\n- 插件运行时只读取包内自带的 `skills/` 目录，用于通过 DSH 标准 filesystem skill provider 注册技能。\n- 它会在会话首轮向模型上下文注入配置好的 gate 文本。\n- 它不读取凭据，不发起网络连接，也不访问 DSH 会话上下文之外的用户数据。\n- 实际使用技能时，模型会像使用其他编码技能一样，按用户指示读取项目文件。\n\n## 故障排查\n\n- 技能在 DSH 中不可见：确认 DSH 版本支持 `ctx.skills` 与 Agent Skills 发现，并在安装后重启 profile。\n- Gate 未注入：检查 `enabled` 是否为 `false`，以及 profile patch 中是否存在 `id: logicprobe` 的行。\n- 插件管理器拒绝安装：确认 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包声明在 `peerDependencies` 中，而不是 `dependencies`。\n- 手动复制后 DSH 仍看不到技能：改用原生 bundle 安装（`dsh plugin add \"github:AmethystLuna/logicprobe\"`）。\n\n## 开发\n\n```bash\nnpm install\nnpm run typecheck\nnpm run build\n```\n\n测试链：\n\n| 命令 | 内容 |\n|---|---|\n| `npm run test:engine` | 状态机与数据模型引擎回归（`tests/engine`、`tests/data-engine`、`tests/concurrency`、`tests/uml`、`tests/apply-smoke`、`tests/dsh-client-half`、`tests/exporters`、`tests/external`），再加 Python 逐字节一致性对照。对照脚本是 `tests/python/run.mjs`，它把同一批 fixture 在 TS 引擎与 `tools/python/logicprobe-engine.py` 之间比对报告、组合与导出产物。无 Python 时自动 SKIP。 |\n| `npm run test:full` | `tests/full-suite.mjs` 端到端合并套件 |\n| `npm run test:python` | 仅 Python parity（构建 + `tests/python/run.mjs`） |\n| `bash tests/skill-triggering/run-all.sh` | 触发测试，位于 `tests/skill-triggering/` |\n\n## 许可证与安全\n\n本项目使用 MIT 许可证，见 A future reviewer must be able to see what was verified and when.\n\n\n## Methodology\n\n### Phase 1: Enumerate Claims\n\nRead the document fully. Extract every claim that is verifiable:\n\n- Numeric claims (counts, sizes, frequencies)\n- API/type/enum names\n- File paths and line numbers\n- Mechanism descriptions (\"compile-time resolution\", \"static dispatch\")\n\n### Phase 2: Verify Against Codebase\n\nFor each claim, run the relevant verification:\n\n- **Numeric claims**: `grep -c` or `grep -rn` to get the real count\n- **API/type names**: extract actual signatures from headers\n- **Enum/constant values**: list actual values from BSP/config headers\n- **Mechanism feasibility**: check language standard and compiler support\n\n### Phase 2 Trigger: Escalate to Logic Primitive?\n\nIf the document under review contains ANY of the following, escalate to [Logic Primitive Verification](#logic-primitive-verification) IMMEDIATELY:\n\n- State machine or statechart with ≥3 states OR with guard conditions on transitions\n- Protocol handshake, ACK/NACK, retry, or timeout sequence logic\n- Claims using absolute language: \"always\", \"never\", \"guaranteed\", \"all paths\", \"cannot\", \"impossible\"\n- Lock/unlock, alloc/free, start/stop paired operations where ordering matters\n- Any logic where correctness depends on transition completeness or event ordering\n- **Refactoring that modifies state topology**: splitting/merging states, adding/removing transitions, changing guard conditions, extracting sub-machines\n\n**Heuristic**: If the transition-to-state ratio > 1.5 or any transition has a guard condition, the machine is complex enough to warrant verification — regardless of state count. For refactoring, trigger if the refactoring changes ≥1 state or ≥2 transitions from the original model.\n\n### Phase 3: Gap Analysis\n\nClassify findings by severity:\n\n1. **Architecture-level**: claims that make the design unimplementable (fake APIs, missing modules)\n2. **Mechanism-level**: claims the language/compiler cannot fulfill\n3. **Consistency-level**: internal contradictions across documents\n\n### Phase 4: Root Cause\n\nFor each error, identify why it happened:\n\n- Wrong mental model (C++ constexpr thinking in C99)?\n- Incomplete search scope?\n- Copy-paste from other projects without verification?\n- Misunderstanding of compiler/linker behavior?\n\n### Phase 5: Structured Output\n\nEach finding includes:\n\n- Exact location (file:line or section)\n- What the document claims\n- What the codebase actually contains (with evidence — grep output, line numbers)\n- Correction direction\n\n---\n\n## Logic Primitive Verification\n\nWhen Phase 2 triggers escalation, do NOT proceed to Phase 3 until the verification pipeline below is complete. Trust models, not intuition.\n\n### Pipeline Overview\n\n```text\nDocument claims → Extract model → Runtime check:\n ├── DSH + `logicprobe_verify` tool available → build Model schema v1 (references/dsh-model-schema.md) → call the tool → structured report\n └── No engine available → Manual Verification Mode (see references/logic-verification-guide.md#manual-verification-mode)\n\nRefactoring variant:\n Old code + Refactoring plan → Extract BEFORE model + AFTER model\n → Run the pipeline on the AFTER model (the same checks)\n → Compare BEFORE vs AFTER: behavioral preservation, regression, complexity delta\n → Flag any invariant that held in BEFORE but fails in AFTER\n\nUML modelling variant (the task is to draw a flow, not to check a claim):\n Code flow → model with a citation per element → logicprobe_uml action=render → diagram\n → logicprobe_uml action=review → modelling findings + render/parse round-trip fidelity\n → logicprobe_verify → the behavioural checks (S1-S8 / A1-A14)\n```\n\n### Budgeting the Model Before You Run It\n\nSearch cost is the declared domain times the number of states — and a declared range is\nnot a bound on the search.\n\n- **`inc`/`dec` are never clamped to `min`/`max`.** The declaration is a property the\n checks verify, not a limit the engine enforces. A counter whose guard does not pin it\n ranges past its own declaration, so the reachable set is unbounded however small the\n declared range looks; S8 reports that as `S8_DOMAIN_NOT_ENFORCED`.\n- **Bound a counter with a guard, not a narrower declaration.** `max: 4` with a guard\n `retry < 4` closes the loop. `max: 4` alone does not.\n- **Say the budget before running**: values per variable x states. A product in the\n 10^5-and-up range will hit the cap and come back undecided.\n- **Model the check where the code performs it.** A cap check that lives inside the tick\n handler is a guarded branch of the tick event, not a separate event: as a separate event\n the environment can starve it, and the leads-to failure you then read is an artefact of\n the model rather than a property of the code.\n\n### Native dsh Tools\n\n| Tool | Covers |\n|------|--------|\n| `logicprobe_verify` | S1-S8 structural + A1-A14 adversarial, including A12 budget / worst-case path cost, A13 probabilistic reachability over a DTMC, and A14 discrete-tick deadlines. `beforeModel` + `stateMapping` add the D1-D4 before/after regression. |\n| `logicprobe_datamodel_verify` | Data models and schema migrations: DS/DA checks plus the DD1-DD4 data regression. See the `logicprobe-datamodel` skill. |\n| `logicprobe_compose_verify` | Two or more machines checked together (rendezvous handshake semantics): C1 composition deadlock, C2 rendezvous never fires. |\n| `logicprobe_concurrency_scan` | Mines concurrency claims (thread-safe, lock-free, race condition, mutex, ISR-safe) and routes them to dedicated verification. It does not prove concurrency safety. |\n| `logicprobe_export` | Emits external-checker input from a verified model: UPPAAL, TLA+, PRISM, SPIN. |\n| `logicprobe_uml` | render / parse / review / explain-labels for UML modelling — the diagram domain belongs to the `logicprobe-uml` skill. |\n| `logicprobe_structure_verify` | Reviews a structure diagram as a dependency graph. It reports isolated nodes, dangling endpoints, cycles, disallowed edges, layer violations and missing required edges, and it checks refinement across declared levels. The diagram domain belongs to the `logicprobe-structure` skill. |\n| `logicprobe_report_diff` | Compares two reports of the same family. A finding's identity is its check, its code and its machine-readable locator, so reworded prose reads as changed rather than new. This is slice acceptance computed instead of eyeballed. Without the tool, `verify --baseline REPORT` prints the same diff. |\n\nThe repository engine mirrors the same checks for hosts without the native tools, and its `--help` lists the subcommands. Two capabilities have no mirror. Data-model verification takes the data harness or the manual mode there. The concurrency claim scan is the same story: `logicprobe-concurrency` routes the claims instead. That engine prints the report JSON, not the body — the body is the dsh tools' rendering.\n\n### Reading a Report: `ok` Is Not a Verdict\n\nEvery tool report carries the same outcome contract. **`ok` says a report was produced; `verdict` says how the review went.** A report may be `ok: true` and still be a failed review — gating on `ok` is how a failing verification gets read as a passing one.\n\n| Field | Meaning |\n|-------|---------|\n| `schema` | The versioned report contract (`logicprobe/verify/v1`, `logicprobe/uml/review/v1`, …). Branch on this instead of sniffing fields. |\n| `ran` | The tool executed and produced this report. `false` only when the tool refused the request before running (see `errorCode`/`error`). |\n| `verdict` | `pass` \\| `pass_with_findings` \\| `fail`. **This is the outcome you act on.** |\n| `verdictReason` | Why, e.g. `2 error finding(s) (first: S2_NO_TRANSITIONS)` or `no error findings; 3 warning finding(s)`. |\n| `findings[]` | `{code, severity, message, detail?, evidence?, path?}`. Any `severity: \"error\"` forces `verdict: \"fail\"`. |\n| `hashSpec` | Which published model-hash specification `modelHash` follows — see `references/hash-spec.md`. |\n| `hashes` | Every hash the report carries, in one place (a model hash, a diagram hash, before/after hashes). |\n| `nextSteps[]` | What to do next, derived from the findings; never empty, and identical for two runs over the same input. |\n| `metadataKeys[]` | Paths of the `_`-prefixed annotation keys the schema ignored, e.g. `[\"_source\", \"_verified\", \"states[0]._note\"]` (present only when the input carried any). |\n| `narrativeCoverage` | `{states: \"5/5\", events: \"3/9\", scenarios: \"0/12\"}` when the model carries a narrative — a partial narrative is valid, and this is how much is still undocumented. The gap is also a `NARRATIVE_PARTIAL` (info) finding, so a gate can read it without parsing `nextSteps` text. |\n\nA tool prints a body, not JSON. Passing checks stay in the `CHECKS` inventory line, and a fact that several checks report is listed once. Only error findings inline their evidence. Pass `reportView: \"full\"` when you need the structured report itself, for example to hand it to `logicprobe_report_diff`.\n\nTurn the verdict into an answer, never into a summary of `ok`:\n\n- `verdict: \"pass\"` — no error and no warning finding. Safe to report as verified, still with the scope the model covered.\n- `verdict: \"pass_with_findings\"` — verification ran clean, but warnings exist (e.g. `S5` implicit-ignore events, `UML012_NO_TERMINAL`). Report the pass **and** the warnings; do not silently upgrade it to \"no issues\".\n- `verdict: \"fail\"` — an error-severity finding exists, or the input was rejected (`MODEL_INVALID`). Say plainly that the claim is **not** verified, quote the counterexample path the finding carries, and only then propose a correction. Never describe a `fail` as \"the tool ran successfully\".\n\nExit codes: `0` for `pass` / `pass_with_findings`, `2` for `fail`, a refusal, or an unreadable input. In DSH the native tools return the report as data — read `verdict`, and treat `errorCode`/`error` as the refusal path.\n\n`summary.truncated: true`, or a finding whose code ends in `_UNDECIDED`\n(`S7_UNDECIDED`, `A7_UNDECIDED`, `A9_LEADS_TO_UNDECIDED`, `D2_UNDECIDED`), means the search\nstopped before deciding. That is **not** a pass: name the invariant that went undecided,\nand say the property is undecided rather than reading the silence as success.\n\n### Writing the Answer: Name the Finding, Not Its Code\n\n`S2_NO_TRANSITIONS`, `UML019`, `DA2` are values of `findings[].code`, not names. A reader\nwho has not memorized the schema learns nothing from one, and cannot tell whether their\nmachine is sound or stuck.\n\n- **Say what it means**, in the user's language and in the terms of their own code:\n 「启动超时后 ERROR 没有任何出口迁移，机器会停在那里」, not 「S2 命中」. The finding's\n `message` is written for the report; the sentence for the user is written from it.\n- **Keep the identifier where the identifier is the subject**: a report field quoted\n verbatim, a baseline diff, a test name, or a question about the check itself.\n- **Name the property, not the checking.** \"This path locks without unlocking\" beats\n \"A4 failed\". A check's name earns its place when the reader asked about the checking.\n- **Carry the verdict in words.** \"Not verified\" or \"verified, within the scope of this\n model\" — never a bare pass, and never a warning presented without its label.\n\nA reader who cannot tell what failed will either trust a report they cannot read, or\nignore one they should act on.\n\n### Slice Acceptance: Baseline Diffs\n\nThe acceptance criterion for a refactoring slice is usually \"no **new** findings\", not\n\"zero findings\". Do not compare two JSON reports by eye — run the comparison:\n\n- DSH: `logicprobe_report_diff { baseline: , current: }`\n- Any host without the tools: run the repository engine against the same JSON.\n (also available on `compose`, `structure` and `uml-review`)\n\nA finding's identity is its **check id + code + canonical locator** (built from\n`evidence`/`path`; the message only when a finding carries neither), so a reworded\nmessage reads as `changed`, never as a new finding. The diff's `verdict` describes the\n**delta** — a newly added error finding fails it — while `currentVerdict` keeps the\nabsolute result visible, and a clean delta over a still-failing report says so in\n`nextSteps` rather than passing quietly. Two runs over the same input add zero findings:\nrun that self-check before trusting any baseline.\n\n### Archiving a Model: `_`-Prefixed Metadata\n\nKeep provenance with the model instead of in a sidecar that drifts:\n\n- Any key starting with `_` at any level (`_source`, `_verified`, `_uml`, `_extraction_caveats`, `states[0]._note`) is **annotation metadata**: the schema ignores it, `modelHash` excludes it, and the report echoes it as `metadataKeys`.\n- Everything else stays closed — a mistyped `sttes` is still a validation error, and that is deliberate.\n- Because the hash ignores `_` keys, \"the model as archived\" and \"the model with metadata stripped\" hash identically; record the reported `hashSpec` next to the hash so a later reader can reproduce it (`verify model.json --hash-check ` answers whether a recorded hash belongs to a published spec at all).\n\n### Refactoring Verification Mode\n\nWhen the document under review is a refactoring plan (modifying existing state machine logic, not designing from scratch), adapt the pipeline:\n\n1. **Extract the BEFORE model** from the existing codebase (not the plan — verify what the code actually does, not what the plan claims it does)\n2. **Extract the AFTER model** from the refactoring plan\n3. **Show both tables AND their model narratives** to the user side by side and confirm the delta is intentional\n4. **Run Phase 2a + 2b on the AFTER model** — the same checks a new design gets\n5. **Compare BEFORE vs AFTER**:\n\n | Check | Method | Severity if Violated |\n |-------|--------|:---:|\n | Behavioral preservation | Every event sequence accepted by BEFORE must also be accepted by AFTER (or explicitly removed per plan) | Error — regression |\n | Invariant continuity | Any invariant that held in BEFORE must hold in AFTER (unless the refactoring explicitly changes it) | Error — undocumented behavior change |\n | Deadlock regression | New states or transitions must not introduce deadlocks not present in BEFORE | Error |\n | Complexity claim | If plan claims \"simpler\": count states + transitions + guards. Is AFTER objectively simpler? | Warning — unsubstantiated claim |\n | Unreachable code | New states added in AFTER must be reachable (otherwise they're dead code from the start) | Warning |\n\n In DSH, pass `beforeModel` and optional `stateMapping` to `logicprobe_verify`; the engine runs D1 Behavioral Preservation, D2 Invariant Continuity, D3 Regression Delta, and D4 Deadlock/Liveness Regression automatically.\n\n6. **Flag any behavioral delta not documented in the plan** — the most common refactoring bug is an unintended side effect that the plan doesn't acknowledge\n\nRun the checks with the native `logicprobe_verify` tool (model JSON, structured guard DSL, path-aware invariants) — see `references/dsh-model-schema.md`. A host without the tools can run the repository engine against the same JSON. For probe patterns, extraction methodology and manual procedures, load `references/logic-verification-guide.md`.\n\n### Phase 2a: Structural Primitives\n\nRun these FIRST. They establish basic well-formedness before adversarial probing.\n\n| # | Primitive | Method | Severity if Violated |\n|:--:|-----------|--------|:---:|\n| S1 | **Reachability** | BFS from init state; flag all states not in visited set | Warning — dead code |\n| S2 | **Deadlock** | Any non-terminal state with zero outgoing transitions? | Error — machine can get stuck |\n| S3 | **Liveness** | Does the transition graph contain an absorbing cycle that excludes expected terminal/recovery states? (e.g. ERROR→RECOVERING→ERROR→... with no exit) | Error — infinite loop |\n| S4 | **Determinism** | Same state + same event → multiple different targets? | Error — ambiguous behavior |\n| S5 | **Event completeness** | For each state, are there plausible events with no defined transition? | Warning — implicit ignore |\n| S6 | **Guard completeness** | For each transition with a guard condition, are ALL branch outcomes defined? `if (cnt<3) RETRY else FATAL` → both paths must exist in model | Error — undefined behavior path |\n| S7 | **Invariant validity** | Does every reachable state satisfy the plan's stated \"always/never/guaranteed\" assertions? | Error — plan claim is false |\n| S8 | **Monotonic variables** | If a variable is declared `monotonic: inc/dec`, do all updates respect that direction? | Error — counter can move backwards |\n\n### Phase 2b: Adversarial Probes\n\nRun these SECOND. Each probe actively tries to BREAK the model. If any probe succeeds (finds a violation), the plan has a behavior gap.\n\n| # | Attack | Method | Target Claim |\n|:--:|--------|--------|-------------|\n| A1 | **Unexpected event** | For each state S, inject every event E where no transition is defined for (S, E). Log whether the model silently ignores or crashes. | \"All events are handled in all states\" |\n| A2 | **Race interleaving** | For every pair of concurrent events (E1, E2), simulate arrival in both orders: E1-then-E2 vs E2-then-E1. Flag if terminal state differs. | \"Behavior is independent of event ordering\" |\n| A3 | **Order permutation** | For N independent events, permute arrival order. Flag if different permutations produce different final states or violate invariants. | \"Outcome is order-independent\" |\n| A4 | **Pair symmetry** | Match every `start/stop`, `lock/unlock`, `alloc/free` pair. Flag if any state allows a path where a pair is unbalanced (start without stop, lock without unlock). State `onEntry`/`onExit` actions are treated as implicit acquire/release. | \"Resources are always released\" |\n| A5 | **Boundary blast** | Probe counters at 0, 1, max-1, max, max+1. Probe timestamps at 0, tick_wraparound. Flag overflow, underflow, or undefined behavior. | \"Handles all counter/timer values\" |\n| A6 | **Resource injection** | Simulate `malloc→NULL`, `queue→full`, `semaphore→timeout` at each state that calls them. Flag if any state has no recovery path. | \"Graceful degradation under resource pressure\" |\n| A7 | **Counter-example witness** | For any invariant that fails, find the event sequence that violates it and output the exact path. Breadth-first searches (state predicates, sequence, atomicity, budget) yield the shortest witness; the leads-to walk and the probability bound report the witness they found without claiming minimality. | \"This invariant holds\" → refuted by a concrete path |\n| A8 | **Idempotent replay** | For each event declared in `idempotentEvents`, apply it twice from every reachable state. Flag if the second application changes state or is not replayable. | \"This event is safe to retry/replay\" |\n| A9 | **Leads-to** | From a declared source state, every path must eventually reach the target state, or reach one member of a declared target set. | \"This state always progresses to completion\" |\n| A10 | **Sequence order** | Events declared in a sequence must occur in the specified order. | \"backup before modify before commit\" |\n| A11 | **Atomicity** | Once an atomic event starts, the machine must commit or roll back before leaving the scope or terminating. | \"all-or-nothing transaction\" |\n| A12 | **Budget (worst-case path cost)** | With `cost` on transitions (absent = 1) and a `budget` invariant, every reachable path must stay within budget; reports the shortest over-budget counterexample and flags reachable positive-cost cycles as unbounded. | \"Worst-case path cost ≤ budget\" |\n| A13 | **Probability reachability (DTMC)** | With `weight` on transitions (absent = 1) and a `probability` invariant, P(ever hitting the target) must satisfy the bound; solved by value iteration over the absorbing chain. | \"≥ 90% of runs reach SAFE\" |\n| A14 | **Deadline (discrete tick clock)** | State `maxTicks` plus top-level `tickEvents`: a tick step may not keep a state resident past its deadline; reports the over-residency path. | \"must leave within 2 ticks\" |\n\n### Integration Back to Phase 3\n\nFor every probe failure:\n\n1. **Quote** the plan claim verbatim\n2. **Show** the counter-example event sequence\n3. **Classify** severity (Architecture / Mechanism / Consistency)\n4. **Propose** correction direction — never fix inline\n\n### Extraction Rule\n\nBefore writing any verification code, output the model in one of the rendering\nforms below. Default is Form A; switch forms when the machine is large or the\ndisplay area is narrow — never let a table row wrap.\n\n**Form A — integrated transition table (default)**: formal symbols with their\nnatural-language meaning inlined; the scenario each (state, event) combination\nrepresents is the last column:\n\n```text\n状态（含义） | 事件（含义） | 下一状态（含义） | Guard? | 场景（状态+事件）\n------------------------|-----------------------|----------------------|---------|--------------------\nINIT（上电待就绪） | power_ready（电源就绪）| IDLE（空闲待命） | - | 就绪后进入待命\nIDLE（空闲待命） | start_cmd（启动命令） | STARTING（启动中） | - | 收到命令开始启动\nSTARTING（启动中） | ack_received（收到ACK）| ACTIVE（运行中） | - | 启动成功进入运行\nSTARTING（启动中） | timeout（等待超时） | ERROR（出错待恢复） | retry==0 | 首次超时进入重试\nSTARTING（启动中） | timeout（等待超时） | FATAL（不可恢复） | retry>=1 | 重试耗尽转致命\nERROR（出错待恢复） | cooldown_elapsed（冷却结束）| RECOVERING（重初始化）| - | 冷却结束开始恢复\n```\n\nWidth discipline (Form A): keep parenthetical meanings short (state/event ≤ 6\ncharacters, scenario ≤ 10) and estimate every row's display width (CJK counts as\n2) to fit the available area. If any row would wrap, shorten the meanings; if it\nstill will not fit, switch to Form C. A wrapped table row loses column alignment\nand is harder to read than no table at all.\n\n**Form B — sentence blocks (reading-accessible)**: one transition per block,\nscenario sentence first, fixed three-line frame. Use for detailed confirmation,\nusers with reading difficulties, or machines with ≤ 10 transitions:\n\n```text\n第 1 步：就绪后进入待命\n 状态 INIT（上电待就绪）\n 发生 power_ready（电源就绪）\n 进入 IDLE（空闲待命）\n```\n\n**Form C — grouped by source state (large machines / narrow panes)**: one\nsection per state, each rendered as its own small 3-column table\n（事件（含义）| 下一状态（含义）| 场景）; no cross-group column alignment to track:\n\n```text\nDEGRADED_LOADING（降级加载）\n 事件（含义） | 下一状态（含义） | 场景\n first_data（首帧数据）| OK_READY（正常就绪） | 收到首帧转就绪\n fault（故障） | FAULT（故障锁存） | 故障锁存\n power_off（下电） | POWER_OFF（下电） | 下电\n```\n\nEach group table is narrow (3 columns, roughly ≤ 60 display columns with short\nmeanings). If one group's table would still wrap, fall back to a one-line-per-event\nbullet list for that group only.\n\nReading rule: every row/block is one sentence — \"在【状态（含义）】下发生【事件（含义）】\n→ 进入【下一状态（含义）】，即【实际场景】\"。Meanings repeat on purpose: each entry is\nself-contained. The machine-readable model keeps the same information in its\n`narrative` block (`narrative.states`, `narrative.events`, `narrative.scenarios`).\n\n**CRITICAL**: Show the chosen form to the user and ask for confirmation before\ngenerating the harness. Because the natural language is inlined, any entry that\nreads wrong to the user — a state/event meaning that is off, or a scenario that\ndoes not match reality — means the model is wrong even if the symbols are\nconsistent. The #1 failure mode of verification is extracting the wrong model. If\nthe plan is ambiguous, flag it as a finding first — don't guess.\n\n**Exception**: If the runtime reports `logicprobe interaction=auto`, do NOT call\n`ask_user_question`. Instead: (a) cite evidence for every cell/entry — each\nstate/event meaning and each scenario must trace to a source sentence, (b)\nround-trip the filled model (including its `narrative` block) back into the SAME\nrendering form and compare it with the extraction, and (c) mark the report\n`UNCONFIRMED`.\n\n### Code-Level Behavioral Suggestion\n\nWhen the task is NOT document/plan review but involves code-level behavioral questions — e.g., the user is editing source files and asks:\n\n- \"check this timing sequence for bugs\"\n- \"could this state machine deadlock here\"\n- \"is this retry limit safe\"\n- \"what happens if event X arrives during state Y\"\n\n→ **Proactively suggest** logicprobe as an optional verification pass. Do NOT escalate automatically — plan-level verification was likely already done. The suggestion is: \"I can run a logic-primitive verification on this state machine to check for deadlocks, unreachable states, and boundary issues. Want me to?\"\n\nIf the user says yes, extract the model from the existing code (not a plan document), and run the standard pipeline. Output the findings as suggestions, not requirements.\n\nThis covers the gap where behavioral verification is useful even when no design document is being reviewed.\n\n### When NOT to Escalate\n\nSkip logic-primitive verification when:\n\n- The document makes no behavioral/logic claims (pure API listings, config tables, data schemas)\n- The state machine has ≤2 states, no guards, and trivial transitions (IDLE↔ACTIVE)\n- The claim is purely structural (file paths, type names, numeric constants) — Phase 2 grep verification is sufficient\n\n### Routing to the Sibling Skills\n\nThis skill owns behavioural claims. Three neighbouring domains have their own skill, and loading the wrong one wastes the verification:\n\n| Domain | Skill |\n|---|---|\n| Drawing a code flow as UML, or auditing a diagram somebody drew (render / parse / review / explain-labels, round-trip fidelity, component and class diagrams refused) | `logicprobe-uml` |\n| Reviewing architecture, module structure or a dependency diagram (isolated nodes, dangling endpoints, cycles, allowed-dependency and layer violations, missing required edges) | `logicprobe-structure` |\n| Concurrency claims — \"thread-safe\", \"lock-free\", \"no data race\", \"ISR-safe\" — mined and routed to TSan/Helgrind/CBMC/TLA+, never proven here | `logicprobe-concurrency` |\n| Entities, fields, relationships, data invariants, schema migrations (DS1-DS4, DA1-DA12, DD1-DD4) | `logicprobe-datamodel` |\n\n### The Same Domains in the Successor\n\n[dsh-model-everything](https://github.com/AmethystLuna/dsh-model-everything) covers each domain above with one skill, and adds two this plugin does not have. Use the mapping when both plugins are installed — the successor's skill is the one to load for new work, because its tools are the ones its own guidance names:\n\n| This plugin | `dsh-model-everything` | What the successor adds |\n|---|---|---|\n| `logicprobe` | `model-everything` | the same doctrine over `model_verify`, `model_compose_verify` and `model_export` |\n| `logicprobe-uml` | `model-everything-uml` | more diagram families (timing, profile, composite, communication, interaction overview) |\n| `logicprobe-structure` | `model-everything-structure` | multi-level refinement between drawings |\n| `logicprobe-datamodel` | `model-everything-datamodel` | the same DS/DA/DD families over `model_datamodel_verify` |\n| `logicprobe-concurrency` | `model-everything-interleaving` | async vocabulary, a family per claim, and a lost update decided rather than routed |\n| — | `model-everything-design` | layering, substitutability, interface width (no counterpart here) |\n| — | `model-everything-report-reading` | how to read a report (no counterpart here) |\n\n---\n\n## Red Flags\n\nIf you catch yourself thinking any of these, stop:\n\n| You think | Reality |\n|-----------|---------|\n| \"Too simple to check\" | The check is cheap.
